submission.justification: Monte Carlo scan (statistical uncertainty only, 140 fb^-1): S2 gives 3.70/4.07/4.20/4.11/3.75 sigma at 30/40/50/60/70% signal efficiency. S1 gives 3.10/3.32/3.35/3.54/3.16, with its best point at 60%. S3 gives 2.57 at 50%. These agree with the 2025 summary (4.1/3.4/2.6 sigma). S2 at about 50% efficiency has the highest expected significance. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: none of the project documents contains data/MC comparisons from the signal-free validation region. So I could not check the hard 10% mismodelling requirement for any strategy. This matters most for S2, which uses jet substructure variables. These are often poorly modelled. This recommendation depends on the validation-region check passing for every S2 input variable, which has to happen before the selection freeze. If any S2 input variable is off by more than 10%, S2 cannot be used. The next choice would be S1 (kinematic variables only) at about 60% efficiency (3.54 sigma), provided its variables pass the same check. The significances leave out systematic uncertainties.

requirements.evidence: S2 at 50% efficiency: 4.20 sigma (statistical only). This is the highest point scanned across S1, S2 and S3.
